title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.1-rc.13
summary: A clearer transfer window with glossy queue arrows, file/folder icons, full-width progress bars and title-bar totals.
changes: Move queued files and folder groups up or down from either PC. The sender confirms order; already-copying files finish and paused files stay paused.
Use consistent full-width progress bars, compact row separators, and cached Windows file-type/folder icons.
Move overall percentage, combined speed and ETA into the title bar, with clear Preparing, Paused and needs-attention states.
Keep the compact RC11 settings and RC12 acknowledged startup and connection-timeout retries. Simplify the README introduction.
testing: Install RC13 on BOTH PCs. Send two folders and a large loose file; check icons, row separators, full-width bars and title-bar progress.
Move a started folder below another entry on either PC. Current files should finish; the higher entry should take the next available slots. Check the other window agrees within a few seconds.
Pause one file, wait for it to stop, move it, and verify it stays paused. Reorder children within an expanded folder, then collapse/reopen it.
Cancel while reordering, then disconnect/reconnect during a disposable transfer. Completed files must remain intact; resume/retry unfinished work explicitly when paused.
Check window resizing and your Windows display scaling. Recheck mouse/keyboard sharing, clipboard, sleep/wake and settings.
known_limitations: Queue arrows on the receiving PC need RC13 or newer on the sender. Use the same RC on both PCs.
Each sender/destination pair has its own order; four outgoing file workers are shared across destinations. Arrows do not interrupt files currently copying.
ETA is an estimate of remaining copying, not a promise about verification time. Wi-Fi saturation can still cause mouse lag.
Automated Windows tests do not replace real two-PC validation, including disconnect and sleep/wake behavior.
